name: amp
description: Amp - AI coding agent for the terminal

options.name: --visibility
options.description: Set thread visibility (private, unlisted, workspace, group)

name: -V
--version
options.description: Print the version number and exit

options.name: -v
options.description: Alias for --version

options.name: --notifications
options.description: Enable notification alerts (audio locally, terminal bell over SSH or with AMP_FORCE_BEL; enabled by default when not in execute mode)

options.name: --no-notifications
options.description: Disable notification alerts (audio locally, terminal bell over SSH or with AMP_FORCE_BEL; enabled by default when not in execute mode)

options.name: --color
options.description: Enable color output (enabled by default if stdout and stderr are sent to a TTY)

options.name: --no-color
options.description: Disable color output (enabled by default if stdout and stderr are sent to a TTY)

options.name: --settings-file
options.description: Custom settings file path (overrides the default location /Users/ethan/.config/amp/settings.json)

options.name: --log-level
options.description: Set log level (parent, children, category, sinks, parentSinks, filters, lowestLevel, contextLocalStorage)

options.name: --log-file
options.description: Set log file location (overrides the default location /Users/ethan/.cache/amp/logs/cli.log)

options.name: --ide
options.description: Enable IDE connection (default). When enabled, Amp automatically includes your open IDE's file and text selection with every message

options.name: --no-ide
options.description: Disable IDE connection

options.name: --mcp-config
options.description: JSON configuration or file path for MCP servers to merge with existing settings

name: -m
--mode
options.description: Set the agent mode (low, medium, high, ultra, or a plugin mode by key or label, case-insensitive) — controls the model, system prompt, and tool selection

options.name: --features
options.description: Enable a thread feature (known: fast, Faster serving for supported models, billed at a premium

options.name: --fast
options.description: Run new threads in Fast mode (faster serving for supported models, billed at a premium); alias for --features fast

options.name: --executor
options.description: Run a new thread locally, in an orb, or on a runner (local, orb, runner:<id>)

options.name: --runner-dir
options.description: With --executor runner:<id>, select one absolute directory served by the runner for the new thread

options.name: --no-tui
options.description: Run Amp without a TUI: serve remote thread creation requests for the current directory. Use --runner-id <id> to set a stable runner ID

options.name: --share
options.description: Share this --no-tui runner with your workspace while it is running

options.name: --desktop
options.description: Share a desktop with threads served by this --no-tui runner: this Mac’s display, or a private virtual desktop on Linux

options.name: --amp-env
options.description: Inject the Secrets & Env Vars configured on ampcode.com

options.name: --remote-control-terminal
options.description: Enable terminal access from ampcode.com for threads accessed across clients

options.name: --no-remote-control-terminal
options.description: Disable terminal access from ampcode.com for threads accessed across clients

name: -x
--execute
options.description: Use execute mode, optionally with user message

name: -ox
--orb-execute
options.description: When used with -x/--execute, execute in an async orb on the Amp server

options.name: --attach
options.description: With remote execute mode (such as -ox), upload a local file and add its URL to the message. Repeat the flag for multiple files

options.name: --project
options.description: With the orb executor, run the new thread on this Amp project

options.name: --orb-size
options.description: With the orb executor, use this size instead of the project default

options.name: --title
options.description: With --execute, set the title of the new thread before starting the agent

options.name: --stream-json
options.description: When used with --execute, output in Claude Code-compatible stream JSON format instead of plain text

options.name: --stream-json-thinking
options.description: Include thinking blocks in stream JSON output (non-Claude Code extension). Implies --stream-json

options.name: --stream-json-input
options.description: Read JSON Lines user messages from stdin. Requires both --execute and --stream-json

options.name: --plugin-ready-timeout
options.description: When used with --execute, how long to wait for plugins to become ready before running the turn, so plugin lifecycle hooks

options.name: --no-archive-after-execute
options.description: When used with --execute on a new thread or with the review command, leave the thread unarchived after the command finishes

name: -l
--label
options.description: Add a label to the thread created or continued by this command. Repeat the flag for multiple labels
